neha (sdk): FYI repro from a customer: VSCode auto-imports resolved to our CJS build and an edge function started spinning on token refresh.

sam (devex): ouch. what does their import look like?

neha (sdk): `import { create } from 'redwood-client'` inside a Vercel Edge API route. package.json only exposes import/require at root, no /edge subpath.

arun (platform): that makes editors prefer the CJS path in some setups. on edge that triggers our fallback polyfills (nextTick/setImmediate) which aren't present -> retry timers misbehave.

maria (docs): can we change the sample app to explicitly import from a documented edge entrypoint while we patch the package?

neha (sdk): plan: 1) add `exports."./edge"` -> ESM edge bundle, 2) include `types` for that subpath (dist/edge.d.ts), 3) replace setImmediate-based backoff with a Promise.sleep using AbortSignal.

sam (devex): also add a short FAQ blurb and a one-line quickstart snippet: `import { create } from 'redwood-client/edge'` for edge runtimes.

integrations-bot: created preview for sample PR: https://preview.app/vercel/samples/edge-import-fix (reaction :white_check_mark:)

arun (platform): add a CI smoke that runs `tsc --noEmit` on the sample and a minimal worker-like smoke test to catch this before release.

neha (sdk): opened internal issue #4301 with repro, logs, and proposed package.json diff. assigning to arun and maria.

maria (docs): will update quickstart and troubleshooting. adding note about editor auto-imports and types subpath.

sam (devex): thanks — once patched we should convert this checklist into a small playbook for dual-publish (edge build, exports./edge, types per subpath, runtime-safe timers, sample CI).
